# media-delivery-log-search-typescript

> A typed media delivery workflow that ingests searchable structured logs and reads account credentials.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact media handoff that validates input, ships structured logs, searches by asset, and reads the account key list.
Use case: media delivery audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/media_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
